description: This file defines the interface 'KnownConfigValue' which represents a well-known configuration value with methods for retrieving a default value and a configuration path.

classes.name: KnownConfigValue
classes.description: An interface representing a well-known configuration value with a default value and a config path.

methods.name: getDefaultValue
methods.description: Returns the default value to fall back to if no value was set in configuration.
